purpose: Curated currency status for official guidance documents cited by canonical rules. Lives outside data/ so it needs no schema change. scripts/check_authority_supersession.py reads it and fails closed when a CURRENT rule rests solely on a superseded or rescinded document.

DCP 26-03-124.title: Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124, Pharmacist Administration of Medications
DCP 26-03-124.issuer: Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Health Professions Licensure, Drug Control Program; Board of Registration in Pharmacy
DCP 26-03-124.evidence: The circular states: This Circular replaces DCP 23-04-118, dated April 21, 2023, by adding pharmacist authorization to administer the following: testosterone for gender-affirming care, medications for prevention of HIV, and medications for treatment and prevention of sexually transmitted infections.

DCP 23-04-118.title: Circular Letter DCP 23-04-118, Pharmacist Administration of Medications
DCP 23-04-118.evidence: Named as replaced in the Summary of Changes of DCP 26-03-124.

DCP 19-2-105.title: Circular DCP 19-2-105, Pharmacist Administration of Medications for the treatment of Mental Illness and Substance Use Disorder
DCP 19-2-105.evidence: Displaced by the pharmacist-administration circular line that DCP 26-03-124 now heads. Cited by canonical rule MA-MH-SUD-ADMIN, which is why the incident occurred.
DCP 19-2-105.note: Retained here as HISTORICAL provenance for audits bound to older hashes. It must not be cited as current authority.
